comments.overrides: node-sass 4.x has no arm64/Node 20 binary and cannot build from source. sass-loader 6 predates the `implementation` option, so aliasing node-sass to dart-sass is the only lever.
comments.build: cgb-scripts needs NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider on Node 17+, and it exits 0 even when compilation fails - always check the log for 'Built successfully'.
